title: Bullish: Bitcoin, Blockchain, and Crypto Stories
author: Rob Finch
description: Welcome to Bullish, a podcast featuring stories from the incredible world of Bitcoin, Blockchain, and Crypto. Bullish is made by Rob Finch, a crypto entrepreneur who first dove down the Bitcoin rabbit hole in 2013. On Bullish, Rob will tell you stories about a variety of crypto-related topics. Learn about decentralized Virtual Worlds, dystopian futures like Bitcoin Citadels, investment stories about Time Preference, and so much more. Ultimately, one thing is for sure: the future for crypto is Bullish.
